declared_desc: Wood pellets for renewable biomass fuel
true_desc: High-value roundwood and logs from primary virgin forest
fraud_mechanism: Grinding or chipping roundwood or mislabeling whole logs as industrial pellets to bypass stringent EUTR/EUDR DDS scrutiny.
detection_rule: IF HS in ['4401.31', '4401.39'] AND declared_value_per_kg > 0.85 USD THEN FLAG_MISCLASSIFICATION_AUDIT

declared_desc: Cocoa shells, husks, skins and other waste
true_desc: Raw cocoa beans harvested from deforested protected zones
fraud_mechanism: Concealing whole beans under cocoa waste tariff codes with zero import duty and lower sanitary inspection rates.
detection_rule: IF HS == '1802.00' AND net_mass_kg > 5000.0 THEN FLAG_SENSITIVITY_SCAN

declared_desc: Retreaded pneumatic tyres for motor cars
true_desc: Natural rubber latex compounded in illegal plantations
fraud_mechanism: Exploiting EU Delegated Act Annex I exemptions for retreaded rubber tyres to smuggle unverified natural rubber vulcanizates.
detection_rule: IF HS in ['4012.11', '4012.12'] AND origin in ['TH', 'VN', 'KH', 'ID'] THEN CROSS_CHECK_FACTORY_ACCREDITATION
